items.markdown:
If you are looking for Bangkok BTS Skytrain tickets, you can purchase a [Bangkok BTS Skytrain One Day Pass](https://www.overtheplanet.com/%7Blang%7D/unique-experiences-with-bangkok-bts-skytrain-one-day-pass.a%7Bproduct_id%7D?utm_source=gttd&utm_medium=organic&s=%7Bsurface%7D&f=%7Bfunnel%7D&option_id=%7Boption_id%7D&currency=%7Bcurrency%7D) for unlimited rides on the Sukhumvit and Silom lines, starting at approximately 5 to 6 EUR.[[1]](https://www.overtheplanet.com/%7Blang%7D/unique-experiences-with-bangkok-bts-skytrain-one-day-pass.a%7Bproduct_id%7D?utm_source=gttd&utm_medium=organic&s=%7Bsurface%7D&f=%7Bfunnel%7D&option_id=%7Boption_id%7D&currency=%7Bcurrency%7D)[[2]](https://www.nowthingstodo.com/activity/THDP13662/bangkok/bangkok-bts-skytrain-one-day-pass)

*(Note: If you meant concert tickets for the K-pop group BTS performing in Bangkok, there are no active tour dates or on-sale tickets scheduled at this time.)* [[1]](https://www.ticket2attraction.com/discount-tickets/beat-active-bangkok)

Skytrain Pass Details

- **Coverage:** Unlimited same-day travel on the BTS Green Line (Sukhumvit and Silom Lines).
- **Validity:** Expires at 23:59 on the date of use.
- **Redemption:** Exchange mobile vouchers for a physical pass at designated operator counters or station ticket offices.
